missing_requirement_candidates.description: The client independently specifies operating frequency, automatic light sleep, deep-sleep conditions, and timer and touch wake sources; this behavior is broader than GPIO assignment compatibility and has no suitable Requirement in the frozen inventory.
The client delegates selection of good-quality tactile buttons and a switch, which may be an independently evolving component-quality obligation rather than an attribute of the connector inventory.

The client reports DRC hole-clearance and negative-annular-width defects in the USB1 mounting-hole footprint. Footprint manufacturability is independently fixable from connector sourceability and part selection.
